subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Ponzi Operators Build Trust
description: A short lesson to help you apply How Ponzi Operators Build Trust.

hook.text: The best Ponzi operators don't chase investors. They make investors chase them.

buildup.text: They start with a small, exclusive group and deliver real returns to build a reputation.

discovery.text: Happy early investors recruit friends and family. Word-of-mouth does the selling for free.

twist.text: Refusing new investors at first makes the opportunity feel scarce and even more desirable.

climax.text: By the time the scheme opens widely, trust is so deep that due diligence feels unnecessary.

punchline.text: The most dangerous scams feel like exclusive clubs.

quiz.question: How do skilled Ponzi operators build trust?
options: By delivering real returns to early investors
